title: Weakly regular sequences are preserved by localization
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $T\subseteq R$ be a multiplicative subset ($1\in T$ and $st\in T$ whenever $s,t\in T$), and let $S=T^{-1}R$ be its ring localization [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Let $r\geq0$ and $x_1,\ldots,x_r\in R$. Suppose that multiplication by $x_i$ on $R/(x_1,\ldots,x_{i-1})$ is injective for every $1\leq i\leq r$ (the weak regularity condition (1) of [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]). Then multiplication by the image of $x_i$ on $S/(x_1,\ldots,x_{i-1})S$ is injective for every $1\leq i\leq r$. No nonzero final quotient is asserted.
